newsitem.title: GERMANY: Metro offers to buy out Massa shares.
newsitem.headline: Metro offers to buy out Massa shares.

text.p: German retail giant Metro AG has made an offer of 150 marks a share to buy out the remaining minority shareholders in supermarket chain Massa AG, Massa said in a regulatory news release on Tuesday.
The offer to buy up the outstanding four percent of Massa's share capital that it does not already own will take effect from April 28.
It follows a decision by the Massa supervisory board on Monday to sell its 15 self-service supermarkets to Metro at a price of 295 million marks.
The sale requires the approval of Massa's annual general meeting, which will take place on May 23.
